mapper.select: SELECT app.id AS application_id, app.participant_id, g.id AS group_id, g.name AS group_name, COALESCE(ga.leader, false) AS leader, c.checked_in_at, app.revision, app.revised_by FROM applications app LEFT JOIN group_assignments ga ON ga.space_id = app.space_id AND ga.event_id = app.event_id AND ga.participant_id = app.participant_id LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.space_id = ga.space_id AND g.event_id = ga.event_id AND g.id = ga.group_id LEFT JOIN checkins c ON c.space_id = app.space_id AND c.event_id = app.event_id AND c.participant_id = app.participant_id AND c.status = 'CHECKED_IN' WHERE app.space_id = #{spaceId} AND app.event_id = #{eventId} AND app.status = 'SUBMITTED'
